content.text: {"evidence":[{"note":"Directly reuses past workflows/trajectories as skills to reduce forgetting and transfer across tasks.","paper":"P4"},{"note":"Uses reusable structural priors from prior workflow search trajectories for unseen tasks; strong workflow reuse fit.","paper":"P10"},{"note":"Studies experience reuse in memory-augmented agents and forgetting at the memory level, closely related but broader.","paper":"P8"},{"note":"Targets lifelong experience reuse with workflow clustering and recalled skills; directly relevant to avoiding forgetting.","paper":"P4"},{"note":"Memory-driven web agent reuses past failures and behavior; focuses on unseen web environments, not specific workflows.","paper":"P5"},{"note":"Distills expert corrections into transferable rules reused at deployment; about feedback learning, not prior-task workflows.","paper":"P7"},{"note":"Synthesizes workflows from procedural manuals for repeated tasks; more compliance shielding than reusing prior task workflows.","paper":"P1"},{"note":"Addresses tool-mediated unlearning, not workflow reuse or avoiding forgetting of agent procedures.","paper":"P9"},{"note":"Offline debugging and refinement of multi-agent workflows; useful background but not reuse from previous tasks.","paper":"P6"},{"note":"Broad survey/framework for molecular agents; mentions fixed workflows, but not memory reuse or forgetting.","paper":"P2"}],"ranking":["P4","P10","P8","P5","P7","P1","P9","P6","P2","P3"]}
